watchlist_items_pretend_all_or_nothing_c.name: watchlist_items_pretend_all_or_nothing_check
watchlist_items_pretend_all_or_nothing_c.value:
("watchlist_items"."pretend_quantity" IS NULL) = ("watchlist_items"."pretend_unit_cost" IS NULL)
        AND ("watchlist_items"."pretend_quantity" IS NULL) = ("watchlist_items"."pretend_purchased_at" IS NULL)

household_profile_split_check.name: household_profile_split_check
household_profile_split_check.value:
("household_profile"."needs_pct" IS NULL AND "household_profile"."wants_pct" IS NULL AND "household_profile"."savings_pct" IS NULL)
        OR ("household_profile"."needs_pct" IS NOT NULL AND "household_profile"."wants_pct" IS NOT NULL AND "household_profile"."savings_pct" IS NOT NULL
            AND "household_profile"."needs_pct" >= 0 AND "household_profile"."wants_pct" >= 0 AND "household_profile"."savings_pct" >= 0
            AND "household_profile"."needs_pct" + "household_profile"."wants_pct" + "household_profile"."savings_pct" = 100)
